original_request: Write a complete short story about Agent Lee learning responsibility and make sure it has a beginning, middle, climax, and ending.
steps: Define story premise, genre, theme, and target emotion.
Create characters, hero/lead, conflict, setting, stakes, and ending.
Outline beginning, middle, turning point, climax, and resolution.
Write the full story without repeated chapters or filler loops.
Run quality check for repetition, arc, emotional payoff, and completeness.
Ask for human review and revise if needed.

tools.role: Create the plan, creative package, version history, and structured content.
Select available skills, worker lanes, and capability requirements.
Coordinate planning, approval, routing, and receipts.
Expose plan rooms, previews, website rooms, infographic rooms, and delivery links.
Govern durable storage, manifests, receipts, and memory control.
Perform narration, rap, singing, or podcast voice when performance mode is available.

failovers.rule: Use the best matching runtime lane and return the intended artifact.
If a render lane fails, return the plan room, text package, and receipt instead of pretending the final artifact exists.
If execution is blocked, create a work order for the missing lane and ask Leonard for approval or more data.

standards: Do not pretend the work is complete.
Use the correct tool or worker lane.
Ask for approval before heavy execution.
Return links, files, receipts, and next actions.
Keep Agent Lee's public voice poetic, grounded, brief, and disciplined.
